archetype_reasoning: Extreme clarity, function-first, and high contrast are mandatory for accessibility (WCAG AA/AAA). Avoids decorative distractions in favor of robust, understandable interfaces suitable for users with cognitive or visual impairments.

brand_primary.usage: Main app branding, global CTAs, selected states. Must be paired with high-contrast text or icons.

brand_primary_hover.usage: Hover/Active state for primary brand elements.

module_identity.name: Access Navy
module_identity.usage: The unique identifying color for the 'Access' module (like the purple for Student). Used for module headers, primary accessibility CTAs, and high-trust elements.

surface_active.usage: Selected state background for cards (very light orange tint).

border.usage: 1px solid borders for defined surfaces to aid visual boundaries.

border_focus.usage: 2px solid border for keyboard/accessibility focus rings.

text_primary.usage: Main headings and critical body text. Offers 15:1 contrast on white.

text_secondary.usage: Secondary text and descriptions. Offers 7:1 contrast on white (WCAG AAA).

rules: No centered text for long paragraphs; strictly left-aligned to aid reading flow.
Avoid 'Inter' and generic sans-serifs for headings. Used Work Sans for character and IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility.
Support dynamic text resizing: use relative units (rem) instead of fixed px where possible.

spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white shadow-xl overflow-hidden relative pb-20
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-2xl for main modals, rounded-full for icon buttons
rules: Mobile-first app container mimicking a super-app sub-module.
Generous spacing to prevent accidental mis-taps (vital for motor-impaired users).

navigation_header.design: Sticky top bar, z-50, solid white background with a 1px bottom border. Contains 'Back' button (min 48x48px), Module Title ('SB Drive Access'), and an accessibility settings toggle.

accessibility_needs_cards.design: Selectable bento-style grid. 1px solid border (#D1D5DB). On selection, border changes to 2px brand_primary (#FF5000) and background to surface_active. Must include clear icons (Phosphor) + Text.

vehicle_choice_card.design: Horizontal layout. Image/Icon on left, Details on right. Must clearly state vehicle capacity (e.g., '1 Fauteuil, 2 Passagers'). High contrast price tag.

chauffeur_badge.design: Inline tag or pill component. Deep Navy background (#0A2540) with White text and a verified checkmark icon. Represents 'Chauffeur Access Certifié'.

booking_stepper.design: Progressive disclosure layout. Large 'Suivant' and 'Précédent' buttons fixed at the bottom of the screen. Step indicators must be purely text + number (e.g., 'Étape 1 sur 4: Besoins').

safety_sos_button.design: Large circular or full-width pill button. Red (#DC2626) background with White text and icon. Placed prominently in the Safety Center.

accessibility_rules.contrast: Strictly minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for UI components. Validated through Archetype 4 principles.
accessibility_rules.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus state (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0A2540] focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility_rules.aria_labels: Buttons with icons only MUST have aria-label. Decorative elements must have aria-hidden='true'.
accessibility_rules.color_independence: Never rely solely on color to convey state. Use icons (e.g., a checkmark) alongside the active color for selected cards.
accessibility_rules.data_testids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

images.description: Confident wheelchair user outdoors, showing mobility independence.
Medical transport vehicle, suitable for specialized rides.
Elderly couple happily using a mobile phone, representing senior accessibility.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use the provided max-w-[430px] container to simulate the mobile-first super-app environment. Center it on desktop with a subtle shadow.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Integrate @phosphor-icons/react for all iconography. They provide the clear, accessible geometries required.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement a simulated Booking Flow (Stepper) that includes: 1) Profile/Needs (Mobility/Visual/Auditory/Cognitive), 2) Equipment/Companions, 3) Vehicle Selection. Use the bento-grid card styles defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure every form element, button, and selectable card has a minimum height of 48px.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use default shadcn styles blindly; override them with the high-contrast color tokens and typography defined in this document.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure all interactive elements have a 'data-testid' property. E.g., 'data-testid="select-pmr-vehicle"'.
